D217.people: All three daughters, in matching black lacrosse pinnies numbered 5, 11 and 4 with the family surname across the back, looking back over their shoulders
D217.event: The three sisters standing together at the edge of a large open grass lacrosse field, turned to look back at the camera
D217.theme: Sisterhood; Sports; Growing older; Growing together
D217.notes: Black-and-white frame of the three sisters in identical family-name jerseys, tallest to smallest, glancing back across a huge empty field. It reads as one image of the whole sibling set and of the sport that runs through this stretch of the archive.

D218.people: Mother in sunglasses and a black jacket, cheek to cheek with a daughter in a green and gold Jr. Lions lacrosse pinnie
D218.event: Sideline selfie at a lacrosse field, goal and wooded hillside behind them
D218.notes: Warm, close mother-daughter sideline selfie in late afternoon light; the daughter's grin is genuine. Composition and setting repeat elsewhere in the sports run.

D219.people: One daughter standing alone mid-field in a white uniform; a few distant players and sideline figures
D219.event: Wide shot of a girls' lacrosse field under a heavy grey cloud deck, one player in the foreground
D219.notes: Mostly sky and empty grass; the daughter is a small figure and her face is not readable. Useful only as an establishing shot of a game day.

D220.people: Youth players in pinnies and two adult coaches on a turf field; no family member clearly identifiable
D220.event: Warm-up or drills on a lined turf field before a game
D220.notes: Distant field scene of a lacrosse warm-up. No face is legible and no family member can be confirmed in the frame.

D221.people: A daughter in a green Jr. Lions #11 jersey and goggles carrying a lacrosse stick, an opposing player in a white pinnie beside her
D221.event: In-game lacrosse action, running with the ball through a field full of dandelions
D221.notes: Clean action frame with her name and number readable and the whole field gone to dandelions. Shows a daughter fully absorbed in her own thing rather than posing.

D222.people: Mother in sunglasses and a Jr. Lions shirt with a daughter wearing a lacrosse pinnie and a medal around her neck
D222.event: Selfie under a pop-up tent after a tournament, the daughter eating from a paper cup with her medal on
D222.notes: Both faces are wide open with real delight, and the medal plus the snack tell you the tournament just ended. Slightly cluttered background of bags and chairs.

D223.people: Father, shaved head and sunglasses in a white tank top, arm around a daughter in a Jr. Lions #4 jersey wearing a medal
D223.event: Posing together by a batting cage after a lacrosse tournament, the daughter holding her medal out
D223.notes: Straightforward but proud: father and medalled daughter leaning into each other after a win. The batting-cage netting frames them oddly but does not spoil it.

D224.people: A daughter alone with her back to camera, arm raised toward a Ferris wheel; a distant fair crowd
D224.event: Standing at the edge of a carnival lot pointing up at the Ferris wheel
D224.notes: Anonymous back-to-camera silhouette against a lit Ferris wheel and blue sky. Graphic and unlike the rest of the batch, but her face is not visible.

D225.people: Riders visible in a carnival gondola high overhead, too small and backlit to identify
D225.event: Looking straight up at a spinning fair ride against a bright sky
D225.notes: Upward shot of ride machinery; no family member can be identified. Works only as texture in a fair sequence.

D226.people: One daughter in a backpack, denim shorts and sneakers holding a handmade sign reading 'Last Day'
D226.notes: A ritual first/last-day marker, dated 18 June, with the sign held up for the camera. Posed and slightly stiff, but it anchors the school year.

D227.people: Two of the daughters on the front step; the taller one in a denim overall dress holding a 'LAST DAY!' sign, her arm around the younger one in a blue tee and pink shorts
D227.event: Last-day-of-school portrait at the front door, the two girls holding the sign together
D227.notes: The older sister's arm is pulled protectively around the younger one and both are laughing at whoever is holding the camera. Same day as D226, but this one carries the relationship.

D228.people: A girls' lacrosse team of roughly seventeen players wearing silver medals, with two adult coaches at either end; a daughter is presumably among them but not individually identifiable
D228.event: Screengrab of a social media post showing a team medal photo at the Apex Youth Championships
D228.notes: This is a phone screenshot of an Instagram video still, complete with account icon, mute button and 'Apex Youth Championships' watermark burned in. It records a championship medal but is not a usable photograph.

D229.people: A daughter with braces, hair pulled back, in a 'Cape May' sweatshirt
D229.event: Selfie in the back seat of the car, seatbelt on, trees out the window
D229.notes: Braces, a shore-town sweatshirt and a self-taken car selfie: a specific age caught plainly. Ordinary composition, but it is her own frame, not a parent's.

D230.people: Father with a backpack and one young daughter in a patterned swim shirt and pink swimsuit
D230.event: Standing on a lakeside path at dusk, pink sunset clouds reflected in the water
D230.notes: Father and youngest daughter after swimming, sunset over the lake behind them. Pretty light; the pose is a straight stand-and-smile.

D231.people: Mother in a rainbow crochet coverup, father in a sunset-print tank with a backpack, and one young daughter in a pink swimsuit between them
D231.event: Parents and the youngest daughter posing on the lakeside path at sunset
D231.notes: Both parents and the smallest daughter at the lake, pink cloud reflected on the water behind them. Only three of the five are in frame; the two older sisters are absent.

D232.people: All three daughters in swimsuits standing barefoot on the grass, an American flag and a lake full of swimmers behind them
D232.event: Fourth of July at a lake beach, the three sisters lined up tallest to smallest for a photo
D232.notes: A clean annual-marker frame: three sisters in a row, sunburnt and squinting, on the Fourth of July with the flag behind them. Useful for showing the height gap between them.

D233.people: Two lacrosse players facing off at the centre circle with a referee behind them; one player wears #4
D233.event: Screengrab of an Instagram post from a girls' lacrosse events account showing a game faceoff
D233.notes: Phone screenshot of a social post, with follow button, like and comment counts and caption text visible. The underlying action is decent but this is a captured screen, not a photo.

D234.people: A team of roughly a dozen players in orange pinnies plus coaches posed on a field
D234.event: Screengrab of an Instagram post congratulating the 2026 Apex Grind championship winners, caption text included
D234.notes: Screenshot of a social media post including the full caption block and engagement counts. Records a tournament win but is unusable as an image.

D235.people: A daughter in a navy #7 Trilogy Lacrosse pinnie, seen from behind with a long braid down her back
D235.event: Sitting alone on a bleacher bench in front of a large 'BASEBALL' banner, a drink cup beside her, watching the field
D235.notes: Quiet back-view of a player waiting between games, braid and number centred against the banner. Anonymous by design, which makes it more evocative than the posed sideline shots.

D236.people: Mother lying on a beach lounger with a magazine held up over her face, an older daughter stretched out on the lounger behind her; a crowded beach beyond
D236.event: Reading on the sand on a packed summer beach day
D236.notes: Unposed low-angle shot of mother and daughter sprawled on loungers among umbrellas and beach chairs. Nobody is performing for the camera, which is its strength.

D237.people: The two younger daughters in matching grey camp shirts and stick-on bear ears, each holding a basketball, with face paint on their noses
D237.event: Basketball camp in a school gym, the two of them mugging with balls held up
D237.notes: Bear ears, painted noses and two enormous grins in an empty green-and-gold gym. Genuinely funny and clearly a camp day rather than a posed portrait.

D238.people: Father in a white golf polo and cap with all three daughters in golf skirts and tank tops
D238.event: Posing on the course at a professional golf tournament, water hazard and grandstands behind
D238.notes: Father and his three daughters, arms around each other, on a tournament fairway. The youngest is holding a small sign; the smallest one has her eyes half shut.

D239.people: Mother in a purple tank with an iced drink, father in a white polo and cap taking the selfie, and all three daughters
D239.event: Family selfie at a professional golf tournament beside the water on a bright day
D239.theme: Family of five; Vacations; Sports; The life we built
D239.notes: All five faces crowded into one arm's-length frame, everyone genuinely laughing, tournament flags and a pond behind. The middle daughter's braces date it precisely.

D240.people: Father leaning down toward the youngest daughter at a huge cooling fan, the two older daughters standing to the right
D240.event: Cooling off in front of an industrial spectator fan at a golf tournament
D240.notes: The little one has her hair blown straight back by the fan while her father bends to talk to her and her sisters wait, unimpressed. Candid and specific, though the composition is loose.

D241.people: Father in a 'my favorite people call me dad' shirt and mother in a pink tie-dye top, both in purple face masks, leaning over a newborn strapped into an infant car seat
D241.event: Discharge day at the hospital, the parents with their newborn daughter buckled into her car seat, ready to go home
D241.theme: Becoming parents; Family growth; Parenthood; Milestones; Family of five
D241.notes: The going-home frame: hospital bed, infant car seat with a bow-wrapped newborn, both parents masked. The masks date it to the pandemic and the shirt is the same one worn in other hospital arrivals.

D242.people: A toddler daughter in a striped pompom hat and grey fleece coat, buckled into a pink Little Tikes swing
D242.event: Being pushed on a backyard toddler swing on a cold day
D242.notes: Bundled toddler mid-swing, mouth open, staring past the camera. This is a near-duplicate of D252 on the same sheet.

D243.people: Mother in Christmas pyjamas on the couch with all three daughters, the baby held on the middle girl's lap
D243.event: Christmas morning on the living room couch in matching holiday pyjamas, mother and three daughters lined up
D243.theme: Holidays; Motherhood; Sisterhood; Home; Family of five
D243.notes: Mother and all three daughters in holiday pyjamas, the youngest still an infant being propped up by her sister. Dim indoor exposure and a plain couch, but it dates the family's first Christmas as five.

D244.people: Father laughing in the foreground with all three daughters behind him, the baby wide-mouthed with laughter at bottom
D244.event: Arm's-length selfie on the couch at home, everyone laughing at once
D244.theme: Fatherhood; Sisterhood; Home; Humor; Family of five
D244.notes: Four open-mouthed laughs in one frame, the baby's the biggest of them. Soft, slightly washed-out phone image, but the feeling is completely unforced.

D245.people: Mother in a pink striped dress holding the baby in a white sun hat, two older daughters in front of them (one in a pink tutu holding flowers, one in a grey dress and a party hat), father in a coral polo and sunglasses
D245.event: The whole family posed on a walkway outside a building signed 'Beaver Brook Day Spa', dressed for a celebration
D245.theme: Family of five; Milestones; The life we built
D245.notes: One of the earliest complete five-person frames in this batch, with the youngest still an infant on her mother's hip. The tutu, party hat and bouquet suggest a recital or birthday outing.

D246.people: Father in a white shirt and sunglasses bending over the baby in a high chair, mother laughing at right, a toddler daughter and a young boy in the background
D246.event: First birthday party outdoors, the baby eating a cupcake in a high chair hung with a burlap 'ONE' banner
D246.notes: The 'ONE' banner across the high chair pins it exactly: a first birthday, cupcake already in the baby's fist, both parents leaning in and the mother mid-laugh. Other party guests crowd the edges.

D247.people: Father in a pink polo and sunglasses with a toddler daughter drinking from a lidded cup with a straw
D247.event: Sitting together on a restaurant patio, the toddler solemnly working on a drink
D247.notes: Father grinning at the camera while the toddler ignores it completely and drinks. A small, true everyday-out-to-lunch moment.

D248.people: A young daughter in a tutu holding up a fairy doll, father in a pink shirt in the middle, mother at right
D248.event: Selfie in a bare hallway or lobby after what looks like a dance or performance, the daughter showing off her doll
D248.notes: Three heads pressed together and a fairy doll thrust into the frame; the daughter is delighted. Only one child is in the picture, so the other sisters are elsewhere.

D249.people: Father and mother alone, cheek to cheek, a stranger walking behind them
D249.event: Selfie together outdoors on a wooded path, the mother carrying a backpack
D249.theme: Growing together; Growing older; The life we built
D249.notes: The only frame in this batch of the two of them without any of the children. Relaxed, close and clearly taken on a day out on their own.

D250.people: Mother in an olive tank holding a toddler in a pink cap, father in a red tee with an older daughter on his shoulders; a crowd of strangers on the boardwalk around them
D250.event: Standing on a crowded wooden boardwalk at a summer outdoor event, a yellow balloon overhead
D250.theme: Parenthood; Family of four; Everyday life; Adventure
D250.notes: Both parents carrying a child apiece in a press of other families. Two daughters only, so this predates the third; the surrounding crowd cuts into the frame.

D251.people: Mother in a striped tank, father in a dress shirt and tie holding a toddler on his hip, and an older daughter in a pink striped dress standing in front of them
D251.event: Family portrait on a paved plaza in front of a brick building, everyone dressed up
D251.notes: A dressed-up four-person portrait under a small tree, likely after a service or ceremony. Faded, hazy processing and a lot of empty pavement below them.

D252.people: A toddler daughter in a striped pompom hat and grey fleece coat in a pink Little Tikes swing
D252.event: Being pushed on the backyard toddler swing, tighter crop than D242
D252.notes: Near-duplicate of D242 from the same swing session, cropped closer on her face. Keep one of the pair, not both.

D253.people: A toddler daughter alone at a large dining table with a snack plate and a pink sippy cup
D253.event: Sitting by herself at the kitchen table eating, under a wall sign reading 'let's stay home'
D253.notes: One small child at an oversized empty table, shiplap wall and teal chairs, with the 'let's stay home' sign directly above her. The emptiness is the point.

D254.people: Mother crouched beside a stroller with two young daughters in matching black 'love' shirts; a large crowd of strangers behind
D254.event: At a crowded outdoor charity walk or fun run on a cold day, mother crouching to keep the girls together
D254.notes: Mother down at kid height wrangling a stroller and two toddlers in matching event shirts while the crowd streams past. Distant, small in frame and slightly soft.

D255.people: Mother in a grey knit beanie, a toddler in a pink bear-ear hat between them, and father in a hooded sweatshirt and cap taking the selfie
D255.event: Autumn walk outdoors, parents grinning over their shoulders with the bundled toddler between them
D255.notes: Both parents caught mid-laugh with the toddler deadpan between them and full autumn colour behind. Only the youngest child in frame; the others are not in the picture.

D256.people: Mother, father in a flat cap, and two young daughters in matching pyjamas at a party table; a shop worker in a red apron and other guests behind
D256.event: Birthday party at a doughnut shop, one daughter balancing a doughnut on her head while the other reaches for the whipped cream
D256.theme: Holidays; Milestones; Humor; Family of four
D256.notes: A doughnut is balanced on one daughter's head and her mouth is wide open with glee while the other reaches into the cream. Balloon tablecloth, doughnut cake stacks, both parents laughing behind them.

D257.people: Mother in a 'Mermaid Mom' sweatshirt cheek to cheek with one daughter
D257.event: Outdoor selfie, mother and daughter pressed close with a fence and trees behind
D257.notes: Tight, affectionate mother-daughter selfie; the 'Mermaid Mom' slogan is the only context in the frame. Slight motion blur and harsh backlight.

D258.people: A daughter in a green and white lacrosse uniform and goggles running with the ball, an opponent behind her
D258.event: In-game lacrosse action on a turf field, cradling the ball on the run
D258.notes: Mid-stride action frame against empty grandstands. Competent but very close to D259 and D221 in content.

D259.people: A daughter in a white #4 uniform and goggles running with a lacrosse stick raised
D259.event: In-game lacrosse action on a turf field, stick up and running hard
D259.notes: Sharper of the two action frames on this sheet, with her isolated against the field and her number readable. Still one of several near-identical game shots.

D260.people: An older woman in a black hat at left, a small daughter in a pink mask, an older daughter in a hooded coat, the father taking the selfie in a striped mask, and the mother in a green mask and white beanie
D260.event: Family outing to the Rockefeller Center Christmas tree in New York, everyone in winter coats and face masks
D260.notes: The lit Rockefeller tree fills the background while five masked faces crowd the lens. An older woman, most likely a grandmother, is with them; the youngest daughter is not in this frame.

D261.people: Father in a white cap taking the selfie, mother behind, and two daughters
D261.event: Selfie at an orchard or farm stand on a bright autumn day, a food stand sign visible behind them
D261.theme: Family of four; Everyday life; Holidays
D261.notes: Four faces in warm autumn sun with apple trees and a concession sign behind. Only two daughters are present, placing it before the third arrived.

D262.people: Father in a black face mask holding a toddler daughter in a red buffalo-check dress with pigtails, a doll tucked in her arm
D262.event: Selfie outside a columned building decorated with red Christmas bows, the toddler carrying her doll
D262.notes: Masked father and wide-eyed toddler with pigtails standing up on end, holiday planters behind them. The mask and the bows date it to a pandemic-era Christmas outing.

D263.people: Father in the foreground taking the selfie, mother behind, and all three daughters, everyone in Christmas pyjamas
D263.event: Christmas pyjama selfie sprawled on the floor of the playroom among toys and a ball pit
D263.theme: Family of five; Holidays; Home; Sisterhood; The life we built
D263.notes: All five of them piled together on the playroom floor in holiday pyjamas, every single face genuinely smiling and the toddler in the middle laughing straight down the lens. Grainy low indoor light does nothing to hurt it.

D264.people: All three daughters in pyjamas on the living room rug amid opened presents and wrapping paper
D264.event: Christmas morning aftermath, the sisters playing with new toys around a pop-up tent and slide, gift bags and paper heaped by the fireplace
D264.notes: Wide room shot of the three girls absorbed in new toys with wrapping paper piled by the hearth. Nobody is looking at the camera; it works as a scene-setter rather than a portrait.
